text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYOIL SALES - U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday private exporters reported sales of 25,000 tonnes of soybean oil to unknown destinations for delivery during the 1996/97 marketing year.
WHEAT SALES - Philippine companies bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for March shipment at prices from $153 to $180 per tonne FOB for various grades, Manila traders said.

WHEAT SALES - The sourcing had not yet been confirmed for Egypt's purchase of 110,000 tonnes of U.S. or Australian wheat for June delivery, a spokeswoman for the Australian Wheat Board said. Cairo trade sources said on Thursday that Egypt bought 110,000 tonnes of wheat at about US$167.00 a tonne C+F and one trader said it would almost certainly be of U.S. origin. Sourcing of the wheat in the deal remained to be settled by traders, Australian wheat industry sources said.
WHEAT TENDERS - Lebanon's economy ministry invited international firms or their local agents to tender to buy on its behalf 35,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat for end of March.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan will hold side-by-side tenders for 360,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat. Bids for both tenders will be opened on February 16 and must be valid on February 17. Shipment was for March 5-31.

- Iraq will seek 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat on February 11 under the U.N. Food-for-Oil deal, several U.S. exporters said. The tender would be divided into two lots of 25,000 tonnes each, one for April delivery and the other for May delivery.

WHEAT TENDERS - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has offered 40,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale. An international call set February 12 as the final date for bids had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on February 13.

- Sri Lanka has opened a tender for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat, for delivery in two lots of hard and soft wheat, the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said. The tender, for 50,000 tonnes each of hard and soft wheat, will close on February 7.
SOYBEAN OIL - The Commodity Credit Corp of USDA said it will tender Feb 11 for 11,670 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. Shipment is for March 20 to April 5.
RICE TENDERS - Colombia is preparing to tender for up to 50,000 tonnes of rice to help cover a shortfall in domestic production, Agriculture Ministry sources said.

- Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment in April. March 3 was set as the final date to receive bids and confirmation would be made on March 12.

MARKET TALK - Mexico may be considering the purchase of 40,000 to 70,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat and 20,000 tonnes of U.S. no.2 soybeans Thursday night, several U.S. exporters and brokers said. But they stressed that Mexico had no intentions of buying the wheat Thursday night and was just seeking prices.
